recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not add PractitionerRole to Observation.subject for FHIR-15162; any future PractitionerRole subject expansion should come from a separate final OO decision because the applied seed resolution and later source history support using Observation.focus when the observed person or entity differs from the record subject.
issue_request: FHIR-15162 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Observation. It asked to add Practitioner and PractitionerRole to Observation.subject for observations about clinicians, but the approved disposition instead promoted the focal-subject extension to a core Observation.focus/focalSubject element with Reference(Any) and added guidance discouraging Observation when a more specific resource already fits.
initial_application: The issue was applied in the February-March 2018 Observation focus issue family. Git d06b52856c added Observation boundary and subject/focus guidance under a commit mentioning GF#1443, GF#5162, and GF#14863; git 5c093b94a9 renamed focalSubject to Observation.focus; and git 2cf093cbf3 explicitly referenced GF#15162 while adding the trach-care example that uses subject for the child and focus for the mother/caregiver.
additional_context: FHIR-14443 and FHIR-14863 shared the same focal-subject/focus resolution, and the linked 2018 Zulip thread shows OO intentionally avoided making Observation.subject Reference(Any). FHIR-15825 later increased Observation.focus from 0..1 to 0..*. FHIR-29930 later added Practitioner and other targets to Observation.subject when aligning with DiagnosticReport.subject, but it did not add PractitionerRole. FHIR-40335 later clarified subject, focus, and device usage without changing that conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scoped Observation source has Observation.focus as Reference(Resource), notes explaining subject versus focus, and the GF#15162 trach-care example. The current subject target list's inclusion of Practitioner is explained by later FHIR-29930, while the absence of PractitionerRole is not a missed FHIR-15162 edit.
